decisions.reason: Pins PID 42432 dsh web host as koffi.node holder; native binary locked until that process exits → EBUSY on npm copyfile.
Browser is only the SPA over WebSocket; refresh/closing tabs does not stop the host; ordered procedure stop host → verify exit (tasklist/taskkill) → external pinned install → restart → hard refresh.
Bare name resolves to latest=0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha=0.1.2-alpha.5; explains overwrite of installed alpha.4 as silent downgrade and that unpinned install does not preserve the installed version.

Exact npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 (or combined pinned one-liner) after stopping host; dsh --version must print 0.1.2-alpha.5; dsh web restart; TUI pinned after dist-tags/peer check; @alpha only as mutable option.

README guidance: never bare @deepseek-ai/dsh in combined command, pin exact tested host+plugin versions, warn latest silently downgrades prerelease users, add verify line, keep snippets release-synced.
